title: Session handoff: Rev 339 renewal at the Sonnet tier, with WCLI-91 and WCLI-92 as the successor's next work
description: Session-handoff record per ODOC-480, created and completed in the same tracker-only PR. Written 2026-10-28 because team-lead is renewing the ward-cli worker at the Sonnet tier before dispatching WCLI-91 and WCLI-92: dispatch-floor refused both on this session's model, since they touch release.yml, a plugin manifest, package.json and keychain text (DEC-182 (1); DEC-178 (2), DEC-226). Neither task was started. The note carries the state by ref, the successor's next work, the constraints it will hit, and the rails. The live tracker and repository outrank it.
implementationNotes:
RENEWAL HANDOFF, ward-cli worker, written 2026-10-28 before a tier change forced by team-lead. The live tracker and the live repository outrank this note; read those first (opum-handoff restore mode). This exists so the successor starts knowing what this session knew.

WHY THIS SESSION STOPS HERE
team-lead is renewing the ward-cli worker at the Sonnet tier before dispatching WCLI-91 and WCLI-92 (the 0.1.1 cut, on the operator-approved plan). dispatch-floor REFUSED both dispatches on this session's model: they touch .github/workflows/release.yml, a plugin manifest, package.json and keychain text, which is DEC-182 (1) floor work, and this session ran on deepseek-flash (DEC-178 (2), DEC-226). Nothing of WCLI-91 or WCLI-92 was started, and nothing should be read into the tracker as if it had been.

STATE BY REF, measured at handoff
- origin/main == origin/dev == ad68be6f3ea9c5cfa17be3650f1db65ba1cd1c4a. Working tree clean apart from the untracked .claude/worktrees/ (nine registered review worktrees; DEC-208 says remove none).
- Tag v0.1.0 is an annotated tag object 04b138188283e2a2008dc117b3cc50ee871d0ea2, peeling to 2aff3df1016a19ff666e0b91e0d528c01ab5e92e. Every commit after it is tracker or docs only; the tag was not moved and must not be.
- Release v0.1.0 published 2026-10-26T21:11:40Z, not a draft, not a prerelease: https://github.com/opum-ai/ward-cli/releases/tag/v0.1.0. Asset ward-darwin-arm64 verified by download: sha256 458455e58974aae8d6455332d14f5747f04ee9b055f3163c29142b8e44c84904, cdhash de7b6de95f7d8a2c5089fd1438deef69971c5468, both matching a Mac build of the same SHA.
- No open pull request. Nothing uncommitted and nothing unpushed. WCLI-82 is In Progress with this repository's work complete.

THE SUCCESSOR'S NEXT WORK, in the order the lead set
1. WCLI-91 — its criterion 1 is DONE (root README, PR #200, squash ad68be6). What remains is criterion 2: the Release notes generated by .github/workflows/release.yml print the install runbook as a bare path, not a link. Emit a full https URL to the runbook at the tag. It rides the 0.1.1 cut with its own review, which is why it was not changed between cuts.
2. WCLI-92 — DEC-246 (a4): ship opum-ward from a directory carrying only .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/, so a plugin install fetches nothing. The version agreement (0.1.1 in package.json and the plugin manifest) is held by test/plugin-manifest.test.ts. opum-fleet repoints its marketplace entry at that cut; that repoint is opum-fleet's change, not this repository's.
Both are independent changes riding the same cut. Neither is started.

CONSTRAINTS THE SUCCESSOR WILL HIT
- The verification specialist profile (.lore/agents/verification.toml) sits at its exact 20000-token budget. The change that recorded the 0.1.0 gate results in docs/security-tests.md pushed it to about 20003 and both capacity gates went red; it was resolved by compressing prose, which is not repeatable. The next prose added to that file must RE-HOME a source to a profile that can hold it: node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs fails when a concept ends up in no profile, raising max_tokens is forbidden, and every profile naming a shared source must move together. Re-run lore check, lore validate --strict and that script after any docs edit.
- release.yml was settled by the rv331-ward188c review and by the 0.1.0 cut. Changing the generator between cuts is what WCLI-91's criterion 2 defers, deliberately.
- Tagging: this session's own `git tag -a` was refused by the auto-mode classifier under [Create Public Surface], a hard denial rather than a dialog; the 0.1.0 tag was created and pushed by the operator first-party. Expect the same shape at 0.1.1 and route it the same way rather than composing around it.
- Sequencing lesson learned here at cost: land tracker and docs writes BEFORE the dev->main promotion PR. A tracker commit that lands after a promotion puts main behind dev and needs a second promotion before a tag can go on main's tip.
- Pressing dev to main is ordinary delivery: a PR from dev, checks green on that SHA, then `git push origin origin/dev:main` — the remote-tracking ref, never local dev, never GitHub's merge button.

OUTSIDE THIS REPOSITORY, owing this repository nothing
- The operator sitting (install from the Release, keychain re-approval, profile re-approval, T26 at httpbin.org/bearer), which opum-doc holds; the packet was relayed as 1018.
- The opum-fleet marketplace pin (ODOC-542 AC3).

RAILS, unchanged
No tag, no Release and no ~/.local/bin, ~/.ward or keychain action in this repository, and no real credential ever requested. Remove no worktree.

WHERE TO READ FIRST
WCLI-82's implementation notes carry the rv331-ward188c verdict verbatim and the 0.1.0 cut evidence; docs/security-tests.md carries the gate results; docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md and docs/runbooks/install-and-upgrade-ward-from-a-release.md carry the two procedures. Skills: opum-workflow:opum-handoff, opum-workflow:opum-sdlc, lore, opum-tool-output; quest instructions task-execution before tracker writes.
finalSummary: Session-handoff record per ODOC-480, created and completed in the same tracker-only PR. Carries the Rev 339 renewal forced by dispatch-floor: WCLI-91 and WCLI-92 are floor work (DEC-182 (1)) and this session's model was below the floor (DEC-178 (2), DEC-226), so neither was started. Records state by ref (main == dev == ad68be6, tag v0.1.0 at 2aff3df, Release verified), names WCLI-91 and WCLI-92 as the successor's next work with their remaining scope, and lists the constraints it will hit: the verification profile's 20000-token ceiling needing a re-homed source, release.yml left untouched between cuts, the Create Public Surface refusal on a local git tag, tracker writes landing before a promotion, and the promotion path. Superseded by the successor the lead spawns.
